items.title: Safaricom PLC posts double-digit growth in M-PESA transaction volumes
items.summary: Illustrative note: mobile money transaction volumes continued to climb as merchant adoption widened outside major urban centres, supporting the telco's non-voice revenue mix.

items.title: Banking sector net interest margins hold steady amid rate environment

items.summary: Illustrative note: additional geothermal wells were commissioned, reinforcing the company's position as the country's largest renewable generator.

items.summary: Illustrative note: rental income from the REIT's commercial portfolio supported another distribution in line with prior periods.

items.summary: Illustrative note: app-based policy purchases and claims tracking drove higher retention among younger customers across major underwriters.
